inputs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Down in a dusty little border town
Where the trains roll slow and the sun burns down
There was a man folks talked about
Name of Jake with a thunder shout

Six foot four and built like stone
Worked that land like it was his own
Never said much, kept to his job
But everyone knew old Iron-Handed Bob

[Chorus]
Oh, they’d say “There goes that mountain of a man”
Walking tall through the dust and sand
When trouble came and the sky turned black
He was the one who held the line back

[Verse 2]
One cold night when the river rose
Rain came down and the north wind froze
Town folks running, scared and pale
Bridge about to snap and fail

Jake grabbed rope with steady hands
Said “Hold tight now, I got a plan”
Through the storm and the pouring rain
He held that line like a freight train chain

[Chorus]
Yeah they’d say “There goes that mountain of a man”
Standing strong when no one else can
When the river roared and the ground gave way
He kept the whole town safe that day

[Bridge]
Now the years roll by and the story grows
Like an old campfire that forever glows

[Final Chorus]
And they still say “There goes that mountain of a man”
In every bar and every band
A quiet giant with a heart of steel
The kind of man legends make real
